correctness.rationale: Exact branch dynamics give ℓ_n=2^(S_n−max_{k≤n}S_k). Independent ternary digits plus reversal and weighted ballot reflection prove all finite probabilities. Catalan generating function has only two dominant square-root singularities, yielding explicit even/odd amplitudes. A weighted cylinder estimate establishes the sharp upper Hausdorff bound and repeated negative Dyck excursions followed by an up digit give matching Cantor lower bounds. Full rational enumeration through n=9 and weighted Dyck block checks through m=6 reproduce coefficients; these are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: The motivating unknown is the size and rarity of failures of full vertical-leaf contraction in the classical heterochaotic example. The exact length-one return law yields an all-time observable probability with sharp parity amplitudes, while the exact Hausdorff dimension quantifies a null exceptional set that is nearly full-dimensional. These are intrinsic geometric and statistical invariants complementing the published almost-everywhere shrinking theorem; they are not arbitrary parameter substitutions or finite-table reproductions.
